text.en: Qoder CN 1.41.1, dated 20 November 2026, lets company IT limit a device, through system-managed configuration, to sign-ins only with accounts of a specified company, according to its changelog.
text.es: Qoder CN 1.41.1, del 20 de noviembre de 2026, permite al departamento de IT de una empresa limitar un dispositivo, mediante configuración gestionada del sistema, a iniciar sesión solo con cuentas de una empresa indicada, según su changelog.
text.ca: Qoder CN 1.41.1, del 20 de novembre de 2026, permet al departament d'IT d'una empresa limitar un dispositiu, mitjançant configuració gestionada del sistema, a iniciar sessió només amb comptes d'una empresa indicada, segons el seu changelog.

text.en: Claude Code 2.1.329, dated 19 November 2026, warns in the trust dialog where a folder's hooks are declared, and when managed-settings hooks fail to load, according to its changelog.
text.es: Claude Code 2.1.329, del 19 de noviembre de 2026, avisa en el diálogo de confianza de dónde se declaran los hooks de una carpeta, y cuando no cargan los hooks de la configuración gestionada, según su changelog.
text.ca: Claude Code 2.1.329, del 19 de novembre de 2026, avisa al diàleg de confiança d'on es declaren els hooks d'una carpeta, i quan no es carreguen els hooks de la configuració gestionada, segons el seu changelog.

text.en: Kilo Code v7.8.31, dated 19 November 2026, puts the telemetry preference in VS Code's About tab; telemetry stays off when Kilo, VS Code or environment settings disable it.
text.es: Kilo Code v7.8.31, del 19 de noviembre de 2026, pone la preferencia de telemetría en la pestaña About de VS Code; la telemetría sigue desactivada si la desactivan los ajustes de Kilo, de VS Code o del entorno.
text.ca: Kilo Code v7.8.31, del 19 de novembre de 2026, posa la preferència de telemetria a la pestanya About de VS Code; la telemetria continua desactivada si la desactiven els ajustos de Kilo, de VS Code o de l'entorn.

text.en: GHSA-9x8x-crjq-g64h and GHSA-24pw-rf5p-mgp7, in OSV on 20 November 2026: jupyter-mcp-server management routes can be reached without authentication or via DNS rebinding to take over the Jupyter backend, according to OSV.
text.es: GHSA-9x8x-crjq-g64h y GHSA-24pw-rf5p-mgp7, en OSV el 20 de noviembre de 2026: las rutas de gestión de jupyter-mcp-server son accesibles sin autenticación o mediante DNS rebinding para tomar el control del backend de Jupyter, según OSV.
text.ca: GHSA-9x8x-crjq-g64h i GHSA-24pw-rf5p-mgp7, a OSV el 20 de novembre de 2026: les rutes de gestió de jupyter-mcp-server són accessibles sense autenticació o mitjançant DNS rebinding per prendre el control del backend de Jupyter, segons OSV.

text.en: GHSA-qx49-fqc8-xw99, in OSV on 19 November 2026: the OAuth client of the MCP Python SDK (mcp) could send credentials to an authorization server the MCP server chooses, according to OSV.
text.es: GHSA-qx49-fqc8-xw99, en OSV el 19 de noviembre de 2026: el cliente OAuth del SDK de Python de MCP (mcp) podía enviar credenciales a un servidor de autorización elegido por el servidor MCP, según OSV.
text.ca: GHSA-qx49-fqc8-xw99, a OSV el 19 de novembre de 2026: el client OAuth de l'SDK de Python de MCP (mcp) podia enviar credencials a un servidor d'autorització triat pel servidor MCP, segons OSV.

GHSA-r7wg-f7r2-8wf7, in OSV on 19 November 2026: axon-mcp downloads code without an integrity check, according to OSV.
CVE-2026-77314, in NVD on 19 November 2026: Flyto2 Core before 2.26.8 lets the MCP run_recipe tool load workflows outside the recipe directory, according to NVD.

held.text_en: VS Code 1.147, dated 18 November 2026, adds a preview browser integration that lets agents control the default browser, according to its release notes.
GitHub Copilot's changelog of 18 November 2026 adds connectors for Supabase, Box, Calendly and other services to Copilot.
Qoder CN CLI 1.1.92, dated 18 November 2026, fixes text passed through heredoc being flagged as a dangerous command, according to its changelog.

CVE-2026-130764, in NVD on 18 November 2026: Obot 0.8.0 before 0.27.0 can be led to internal hosts by a remote MCP server's OAuth token endpoint, according to NVD.
CVE-2026-130766, in NVD on 18 November 2026: Obot 0.26.0 before 0.27.0 does not validate the resource identifier in remote MCP server metadata, according to NVD.

CVE-2026-130768, in NVD on 18 November 2026: Obot 0.14.0 before 0.27.0 lets remote MCP servers point to unspecified or IPv6 transition addresses, according to NVD.
CVE-2026-130711, in NVD on 18 November 2026: NocoDB before 2026.09.0 lets an MCP token id resolve roles against another base, according to NVD.
CVE-2026-76807, in NVD on 18 November 2026: Todoist MCP Server before 10.3.3 does not validate Host and Origin on POST /mcp in its HTTP server, according to NVD.
CVE-2026-77283, in NVD on 18 November 2026: obsidian-sync-mcp before 0.5.7 without MCP_AUTH_TOKEN does not authenticate its HTTP /mcp endpoint, according to NVD.

CVE-2026-62964, in NVD on 18 November 2026: Gortex before 0.55.0 lets MCP file tools write outside indexed repository roots, according to NVD.
CVE-2026-75518, in NVD on 18 November 2026: the DOMShell MCP server before 2.0.8 treats domshell_eval as a read-tier tool, according to NVD.
CVE-2026-130750, in NVD on 18 November 2026: Network-AI 5.11.0 before 5.17.2 reflects localhost Origins in McpStreamableServer CORS headers, according to NVD.
CVE-2026-18399, in NVD on 18 November 2026: several Mattermost versions do not enforce the GitLab group restriction in the get_projects MCP tool, according to NVD.
CVE-2026-119220, in NVD on 18 November 2026: the Dokan WordPress plugin up to 5.3.3 matches its MCP endpoint with an unanchored expression, allowing authorization bypass, according to NVD.
